summary: All congregation lifted voice cried night, murmured against Moses Aaron would that we died in Egypt or wilderness, why Yahweh bring us to this land to fall by sword wives little ones prey, let us make captain return to Egypt. Moses Aaron fall on faces, Joshua Caleb rend clothes say land we passed is exceedingly good land, if Yahweh delights he will bring us in land flowing milk honey, only don't rebel, don't fear people for they are bread for us their defense departed Yahweh with us fear not. But all congregation says stone them with stones, glory of Yahweh appears in tent, Yahweh says how long will this people despise me, how long not believe despite signs, I will smite with pestilence disinherit make of you greater nation. Moses intercedes if you kill then nations will say Yahweh not able to bring into land killed in wilderness, now let power be great according as you said Yahweh slow to anger abundant lovingkindness forgiving, pardon iniquity as you have forgiven from Egypt until now. Yahweh says pardoned according to word, but as I live all earth filled with glory, all men who saw my glory signs in Egypt and wilderness tempted me 10 times not hearkened, shall not see land I swore, except Caleb because different spirit followed fully will bring in. Your little ones which you said prey they I will bring in and they shall know land you despised, but your dead bodies shall fall in wilderness 40 years after number of days you spied 40 days each day a year, wander 40 years. Men who brought evil report died by plague. Joshua and Caleb live.
whyItMatters: Kadesh rebellion — people refuse to enter land despite promise, want return to Egypt, Moses intercedes with Exod 34:6-7 attributes, God pardons but generation will wander 40 years, little ones will enter. Shows consequence of unbelief and intercession.

context.author: Traditionally Moses; modern scholars debate the book's final form

keyVerses.text: If Yahweh delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and honey.
keyVerses.why: If Yahweh delights — confidence not in size but delight.

keyVerses.text: ‘Yahweh is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’
After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’
keyVerses.why: 40 days spy becomes 40 years wander — measure for measure.

questions.question: Why does people want to return to Egypt despite slavery?
questions.answer: Fear distorts memory — Egypt becomes better than risk. They say would that we died in Egypt or wilderness, why bring us to fall by sword wives little ones prey, let us make captain return to Egypt. Forgetting oppression, remembering only food. Shows unbelief prefers known slavery to unknown promise with God. Joshua and Caleb say don't rebel, don't fear, they are bread for us their defense (protection/shade) departed. Bread image — enemies are food, easily consumed, because Yahweh with us.

questions.question: How does Moses intercede using Yahweh's own words?
questions.answer: Yahweh says smite with pestilence disinherit make of you greater nation like with Moses earlier (Exodus 32). Moses argues if you kill, nations will say Yahweh not able to bring into land he swore, killed in wilderness — reputation among nations. Then quotes Yahweh's self-revelation from Exodus 34:6-7 — now let power be great according as you said Yahweh slow to anger abundant lovingkindness forgiving iniquity... pardon as you have forgiven from Egypt until now. He uses God's own character as basis — if you are slow to anger and abundant lovingkindness as you said, then pardon. Classic intercession appealing to name.

questions.question: What does pardoned but not entering land and 40 years for 40 days mean?
questions.answer: God says I have pardoned according to word, but as I live all earth filled with glory, none who saw glory and signs and tempted me 10 times shall see land except Caleb and Joshua. Little ones which you said would be prey — they I will bring in and they shall know land you despised. Dead bodies fall in wilderness, wander 40 years after number of days you spied 40 days each day a year you shall bear iniquities 40 years and shall know my alienation/withdrawal. Pardon means not immediate destruction, but consequence remains — generation that refused won't enter, but children will. Measure for measure justice.

glossary.def: Enemies as food — easily consumed because their defense departed, Yahweh with us.
Exodus 34:6-7 name — basis for intercession that God pardons.
Measure for measure — spying 40 days becomes 40 years wandering.
